set.notes: ADVANCED 2026-10-30 (research batch 5). Each council's main submission was fetched for 22 data centre applications in Blacktown, Penrith, Fairfield, Ryde and The Hills: 18 read, 4 restricted (Honeman Close, Macquarie Park, Mamre Road, NEXTDC S4). Ryde's are cover letters whose attachments were not fetched. Keyword screen of grounds, not a coding: hunt log. OUTCOMES, from every archived assessment report of a determined data centre: the local council objected in eight cases - SSD-21342738 lodged outside the exhibition period; SSD-33781208 withdrawn; SSD-41589232 lodged out of time, then withdrawn; SSD-47320208 withdrawn; SSD-70889211 withdrawn; SSD-73761707 resolved; SSD-74069708 maintained; decided by a departmental Director; SSD-24299707 stood and the Independent Planning Commission decided. Delegations of 2020 and 2022 let a departmental officer decide only where the council had not objected; the delegation of 18 August 2026 for data centre projects drops that condition, and Project Apollo was approved under it while Ryde's objection stood. Ryde 'strongly objects' to NEXTDC S5, undetermined.
